question: Show the names of students who have a grade higher than 5 and have at least 2 friends.
gold_query: SELECT T2.name FROM Friend AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id WHERE T2.grade  >  5 GROUP BY T1.student_id HAVING count(*)  >=  2

steps.raw_response: {"sql": "SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE grade > 5 AND ID IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(friend_id) >= 2)"}

final_sql: SELECT name FROM Highschooler WHERE grade > 5 AND ID IN (SELECT student_id FROM Friend GROUP BY student_id HAVING COUNT(friend_id) >= 2)
explain: The SQL accurately selects names of highschoolers with a grade higher than 5. It correctly uses a subquery with GROUP BY and HAVING to filter for students who have at least two friends, joining Highschooler.ID with Friend.student_id. All column and table names are valid, and the query structure is optimal for the requested information.
